cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Verify that dragging a draggable product item li element initiates a drag event and successfully captures the product's title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and Drop Product Item into Drop Area
cases.description: Verify that a user can drag and drop a product item (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') to add it to the cart.

cases.title: Cart Display Automatic Update on Drop
cases.description: Verify that upon dropping a product into the drop area, the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price appears in .box3, and the quantity appears in .box1.

cases.title: Support for Adding Different and Repeated Products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the cart via drag and drop.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price in allMoney element
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit behaviors have been fully mapped to the corresponding test cases without any missing scenarios or blockers.
All requirements and cases have been thoroughly reviewed. The cases correctly map to the specified requirements without any blockers, coverage gaps, or redundancies.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initiating a drag event, capturing the product title, and capturing the product price, with normal scenarios for dragging product items configured as draggable li elements with specific data-testid attributes. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 contains multiple behaviors such as allowing drag and drop into the designated drop area, automatically updating the cart display with product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1, and supporting both different and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 defines multiple behaviors including summing the prices of all products, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displaying the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element.
